title: scopingreview
text:
PPADEM Code & Packages


An automated, user-friendly R pipeline for conducting systematic and scoping literature reviews across Elsevier Scopus and OpenAlex bibliographic databases.

title: scopingreview
text:
🎯 What This Tool Does
This pipeline automates the labor-intensive initial stages of a systematic literature review:

Constructs Boolean API Queries: Combines your thematic search keywords and geographic filters using precise boolean logic across both Scopus and OpenAlex, supporting single-category (OR / AND) or multi-block (multi) search modes.
Queries Scopus & OpenAlex: Programmatically retrieves academic publications, handling pagination and rate limits automatically.
Harmonizes Metadata: Standardizes schemas across both databases into a single clean format.
Performs 2-Stage Deduplication: Merges duplicate papers across databases using exact DOI matching and fuzzy title string matching.
Flags Curated Target Journals: Automatically checks each paper’s journal against a reference list of ~121 top Political Science, Administrative, and Area/African Studies journals and flags them (Y / N) in a dedicated column.
Exports Customizable Datasets: Saves structured CSV datasets directly to root or to custom subfolder paths specified in output_filename.

title: scopingreview
text:
🔍 How the Search Logic Works
Understanding how your search parameters are built into API queries:

1. Topic Keywords (OR, AND, or multi Logic)
Keywords grouped inside each topic category in SEARCH_TOPICS are joined together using the topic_operator setting:

OR Mode (default): ("political party" OR "party organization" OR "party decline")
AND Mode: ("political party" AND "party organization" AND "party decline")
MULTI Mode: Combines multiple concept blocks (e.g. BLOCK 1 AND BLOCK 2 AND … AND BLOCK N), where terms inside each block are separated by OR: ((Block 1 terms separated by OR) AND (Block 2 terms separated by OR)) AND (GEO terms separated by OR)



2. Geographic Terms (OR Logic, Optional)
Geographic terms in GEO_TERMS are optional. When provided, they are joined together with OR operators:

("Africa" OR "Sub-Saharan Africa" OR "West Africa")

If geo_terms = NULL or omitted, no geographic filter is applied, allowing for a general/global broad search.


3. Combining Topics & Geography (AND Logic)
When geo_terms are provided, the pipeline joins the topic group and the geographic group together using an AND operator. When geo_terms is NULL, only the topic query and publication year filter are applied:
Final Query with Geography = (Topic Keywords [OR/AND]) AND (Geographic Terms [OR]) AND PUBYEAR >= START_YEAR
Final Query without Geography = (Topic Keywords [OR/AND]) AND PUBYEAR >= START_YEAR

title: scopingreview
text:
⚙️ Quick Start Guide

1. Installation
Install the package directly from GitHub (R version 4.1+ recommended). Its dependencies (rscopus, openalexR, dplyr, etc.) are installed automatically:
install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("PPADEM/scopingreview")
Then load it with:
library(scopingreview)


2. API Key Setup
Store your API keys in your user R environment file (~/.Renviron). This allows R to automatically authenticate your queries without hardcoding keys in your script:
Add the following lines to ~/.Renviron:
OPENALEX_KEY="your_openalex_api_key"
ELSEVIER_SCOPUS_KEY="your_scopus_api_key"

title: scopingreview
section: 🛠️ Customizing Output File Locations & Search Modes
text:
🛠️ Customizing Output File Locations & Search Modes
By default, files are saved in your current working directory. If a subfolder path is included in output_filename, the directory is created automatically:
library(scopingreview)

# Run 1: General Broad Search (OR mode)
general_data <- run_scoping_review(
  search_topics   = list(party = c("political party", "party decline")),
  geo_terms       = c("Africa", "Sub-Saharan Africa"),
  start_year      = 2020,
  topic_operator  = "OR",
  output_filename = "general_search.csv"
)

# Run 2: Multi-Block Search (BLOCK 1 AND BLOCK 2 AND GEO)
multi_data <- run_scoping_review(
  search_topics   = list(
    parties = c("political party", "party organization"),
    communication = c("communication", "meeting", "social media")
  ),
  geo_terms       = c("Africa", "Sub-Saharan Africa"),
  start_year      = 2020,
  topic_operator  = "multi",
  output_filename = "outputs/multi_block_search.csv"
)

title: scopingreview
text:
🚀 Example Script
A complete example script with three different search runs is included with the package. Copy it to your working directory to use as a starting point:
file.copy(
  system.file("examples", "api_pipeline_example.R", package = "scopingreview"),
  "api_pipeline_example.R"
)
Or view it on GitHub at inst/examples/api_pipeline_example.R.
Help pages are available for each exported function, e.g. ?run_scoping_review.

title: scopingreview
text:
📊 Output File Schema
Outputs are exported to the location specified in output_filename:








Column Name
Description
Example




database
Provenance database source(s)
Scopus; OpenAlex


query_category
Thematic search category or multi-block combination
party_linkages or party_block & communication_block


search_query
Exact Boolean API search query string executed for this record
("political party" OR "party decline") AND ("Africa" OR ...)


search_date
Date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the search pipeline was executed
2026-08-24


scopus_id
Scopus record identifier
2-s2.0-85123456789


openalex_id
OpenAlex work URI
https://openalex.org/W4323539164


title
Article title
Parties, Political Finance, and Representation


journal
Source journal / publication name
Journal of Modern African Studies


publication_year
Year of publication
2023


doi
Standardized DOI
10.1017/s0022278x2300001


citations
Highest reported citation count
14


abstract
Full article text abstract
This article examines...


authors
Semicolon-separated list of author names
Smith, J.; Kwame, A.


target_journal
Flag (Y/N) indicating if journal matches curated political science/administrative/African studies list
Y
